ProblemDetails.description:
RFC 7807 problem. ``code`` is the stable machine identifier clients branch on.

The optional members below are the documented extensions; a domain error may add other
structured details (e.g. ``channel`` on ``channel_not_supported``), hence
``additionalProperties``.

currentStatus.description: invalid_transition, case_closed: the case status now.

errors.description: validation_error: one entry per invalid field.
errors.title: Errors

remainingAttempts.description: invalid_credentials, mfa_invalid: failed attempts left before the lock.
remainingAttempts.title: Remainingattempts

requiredRoles.description: forbidden: roles that may perform the action.
requiredRoles.title: Requiredroles

post.description: Development code: `000000`. Use the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer`. A wrong code returns `mfa_invalid` with `remainingAttempts`; wrong codes also count toward the account lockout, so the failure that reaches it returns `account_locked` (423) with `unlockAt`, as does any attempt while the account is locked.
